caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with five drawers, arranged with two smaller drawers at the top and three larger drawers below. The chest is predominantly dark brown in color, with each drawer front decorated with intricate, multicolored floral and botanical patterns featuring red, green, blue, yellow, and white hues. The designs include curving vines, leaves, flowers, small birds, and symmetrical arrangements, all outlined with fine details. Red borders surround the decorative panels on the drawers, enhancing the central motifs. The sides of the chest display a vertical pattern with a large central flower, possibly a tulip, with two red heart shapes at the base, framed by scrolling white lines. The chest stands on four rectangular legs, and the entire piece is illustrated on a plain, light beige background without any additional objects or context.
title: Guilford Painted Chest
